**STEP 3 - Items:** Almonds only (about 30 pieces). No oil or sauce is visible.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Nuts pack loosely, so I use a bulk density of ~0.5 g/ml, giving ~50 g. A piece count cross-check (~30 almonds × ~1.2 g) gives ~36 g. I take the midpoint, about 40 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Almonds ≈ 579 kcal/100 g. 40 g × 5.79 ≈ 232 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 30 almonds is roughly 35–45 g and about 200–260 kcal, which fits a small handful on a side plate.

**Total:** ~40 g, ~230 kcal (estimate; uncertainty about ±25%).
